title: Hearts Linked With Sheffield United: Gossip or a Genuine Move?
body:
Hearts are at the centre of a transfer rumour that links one of their winger-types to Sheffield United [S1]. The story is built around McPake, whose name is tied to Hearts and a Sheffield United scout in the headline [S1].

The detail that grabs attention comes from a former St Johnstone chairman, who has reportedly revealed a 49ers approach [S1]. That is the kind of claim that turns idle chatter into something with a paper trail. It also means the story is not just whispers from the stands, because someone with past experience of the game has put a specific approach on the record [S1].

The evidence here is thin. There are no form numbers or predictions to lean on, so anyone reading this should treat it as a rumour with one solid hook, not a done deal.

Still, the rumour itself is telling. If this one goes through, it says plenty about where the club thinks it is heading. A side that is happy to sell into a rival's interest is either banking on the money or planning a rebuild around new faces. Neither option is automatically wrong, but both demand a clear answer on what comes next.

The smart money is on patience. Fans should be wary of celebrating or panicking over a story that has not yet produced a signing.

The Touchline Take: judge the business when the window shuts, not before.
